claim: The Home Assistant MQTT notify entity publishes the notify.send_message payload to a configured command_topic, with an optional command_template to generate the payload, but the platform defines no title/message/actions JSON schema and no event round-trip for actionable notifications.
stance_target: MQTT notify entities cannot deliver actionable notifications (action buttons) with an HA event round-trip natively
scope_conditions: Home Assistant 2024.5+ MQTT notify platform; MQTT-discovered or YAML-configured notify entities
quoted_support: The MQTT notify integration lets you send an MQTT message when the send_message action is called. This can be used to expose a action of a remote device that allows processing a message, such as showing it on a screen. ... command_template template (Optional): Defines a template to generate the payload to send to command_topic. ... command_topic string (Optional): The MQTT topic to publish send message commands at.
time_period: Introduced HA 2024.5; doc current as of Sep 2026

claim: The MQTT notify platform supports availability topics, qos, retain, encoding, and message_expiry_interval for queued/retained messages to offline subscribers, but none of these provide interactivity — the payload is one-way outbound from HA to the remote device.
stance_target: A build-your-own MQTT notify path requires custom payload parsing on the device and a separate event channel back to HA for interactive notifications
scope_conditions: MQTT notify entities in Home Assistant
quoted_support: message_expiry_interval map (Optional): Controls how long queued or retained messages sent from Home Assistant persist at the broker for offline subscribers.
